the context budget is 150k to start a summary, 184k to wait for one, and 30k kept, within a 200k window
the context budget judges a model with a smaller window by its own window
the context budget reports the budget as the router model's window, whatever the lane model's own window above it
compaction starts a summary in the background just over 150k tokens, not just under, and the next request carries it
compaction puts the prompt before the conversation after a summary, never a system message after it starts
compaction keeps every message in storage, and gives the page the ones before the summary after a reload
compaction waits for a summary above 184k tokens, so that very request carries it
compaction summarises once when the provider says a request is too long, and tries it again once
compaction gives up after one summary if the request is still too long
compaction loses nothing when the summary fails: the conversation goes on, whole
compaction counts a summary's cost against the demo's caps, like any other call
the summary keeps who said what labels Company text and the agent's notices apart from the User's own words
the summary keeps who said what lets no tool result or Company message forge a User line or close the conversation early
the summary keeps who said what keeps every hostile string inside one line, whatever characters it uses

compaction and Poppy poppy_status with no domain lists everything open at every Company, and no secret
